targets.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.noRegret_limit_nonpos
targets.header:
theorem noRegret_limit_nonpos {X : Type*} (V : Set X)
    (loss : ℕ → X → ℝ) (prediction : ℕ → X)
    (hNR : NoRegret V loss prediction) (u : X) (hu : u ∈ V) (a : ℝ)
    (hl : Tendsto (fun T : ℕ => comparatorRegret loss prediction u T / T) atTop (nhds a)) :
    a ≤ 0

targets.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.limitNoRegret_implies_noRegret
targets.header:
theorem limitNoRegret_implies_noRegret {X : Type*} (V : Set X)
    (loss : ℕ → X → ℝ) (prediction : ℕ → X)
    (hL : LimitNoRegret V loss prediction) :
    NoRegret V loss prediction

targets.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.limitNoRegret_iff_noRegret_of_converges
targets.header:
theorem limitNoRegret_iff_noRegret_of_converges {X : Type*} (V : Set X)
    (loss : ℕ → X → ℝ) (prediction : ℕ → X)
    (hc : ∀ u ∈ V, ∃ a : ℝ,
      Tendsto (fun T : ℕ => comparatorRegret loss prediction u T / T) atTop (nhds a)) :
    LimitNoRegret V loss prediction ↔ NoRegret V loss prediction

targets.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.NoRegretCounterexample.regret_eq
targets.header:
theorem regret_eq (T : ℕ) (u : ℝ) :
    comparatorRegret loss (fun _ => 0) u T = -potential T * u

targets.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.NoRegretCounterexample.normalized_even
targets.header:
theorem normalized_even (n : ℕ) :
    comparatorRegret loss (fun _ => 0) 1 (2 * (n + 1)) /
      ((2 * (n + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) = -1

targets.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.NoRegretCounterexample.normalized_odd
targets.header:
theorem normalized_odd (n : ℕ) :
    comparatorRegret loss (fun _ => 0) 1 (2 * n + 1) /
      ((2 * n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = 0

targets.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.NoRegretCounterexample.no_limit
targets.header:
theorem no_limit :
    ¬ ∃ a : ℝ, Tendsto
      (fun T : ℕ => comparatorRegret loss (fun _ => 0) 1 T / T) atTop (nhds a)

targets.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.NoRegretCounterexample.strict_separation
targets.header:
theorem strict_separation :
    NoRegret (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) loss (fun _ => 0) ∧
      ¬ LimitNoRegret (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) loss (fun _ => 0)
